author: morphisec
text: Citrix confirms two NetScaler RCE zero-days exploited in attacks: CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772, both CVSS 9.5, actively exploited; shellcode placed directly into memory.

author: Netlas_io
text: CVE-2026-58115: Actively exploited RCE in Node-RED (Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050), CVSS 10.0, missing authentication lets unauthenticated attackers execute arbitrary commands.

author: morphisec
text: F5 BIG-IP APM zero-day CVE-2026-94127 actively exploited, 14,700+ instances exposed, added to CISA KEV; unauthenticated RCE in BIG-IP APM OAuth.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to actively exploited RCE CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0): unauthenticated code execution via malicious regex in CI/CD configuration.

author: SCMagazine
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited, critical RCE flaw. Attackers could steal credentials and compromise software supply chains.

author: LawrenceEng
text: WordPress actively exploited core bug: CISA added CVE-2026-119977 to KEV. Attackers race the seconds a core update leaves files in wp-content/upgrade. Update to 7.1.4.

author: agentprime_io
text: WordPress Core 4.7.0 - 7.1.3 Unauthenticated Upgrade-Window Staged-Installer RCE (CVE-2026-119977), actively exploited.

author: nurhayatdev
text: Actively exploited Cisco ASA/FTD VPN flaw CVE-2026-76418 lets an unauthenticated remote attacker force a reload when SSL VPN is reachable and secondary auth configured. DoS, not RCE.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: Ivanti Connect Secure has two more actively exploited bugs (CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527); CISA added both to KEV on Oct 30.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Ivanti Connect Secure active exploitation confirmed: CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527. Apply Oct 29 patches on an emergency basis.

author: cybersec24h
text: Drupal Commerce Core flaw CVE-2026-118539 actively exploited; fraudulent orders priced at $0.01. Fixes: 3.3.13 and 8.x-2.41.

author: ido_cohen2
text: Linux Kernel CVE-2026-46300 actively exploited in the wild, root-level access via missing initialization flaw.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-58115 (CVSS 10.0) in Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 exploited via malicious Node-RED flows to plant Linux bots and HTTP exec backdoors.

author: HacktronAI
text: A critical vulnerability went undetected through multiple security audits; Hacktron AI found it in 10 minutes in Dassault Systemes DELMIA Apriso. It became CVE-2025-5086.

author: Basant_Pandey
text: Docker Sandboxes CVE-2026-103916 (via Endor Labs): sbx cp followed symlinks, so a prompt-injected AI agent could reach host creds and SSH keys. Upgrade to 0.51.0.

author: abhiunix
text: CVE-2026-118306, critical Chrome sandbox escape fixed Oct 27; Playwright 1.64.1 used by AI agents still ships the old Chromium with sandbox off by default.

author: stretchcloud
text: Playwright 1.64.1 ships early Chromium 156 carrying four live CVEs (CVE-2026-118306, CVE-2026-118331, CVE-2026-118348, CVE-2026-118344) with sandbox off; risk for AI browsing agents.

author: morphisec
text: Carbonato botnet installs the Hermes AI agent on hijacked Docker hosts; worm scans for unauthenticated Docker APIs on port 2375 and launches privileged containers.

author: OpenMatter_
text: A contractor reportedly ran a personal AI agent on a Pentagon network for two months, and a tampered Claude Code add-on spent 11 hours in Cursor's store.

author: num1_ch
text: GitHub reported a vulnerability linked to AI agents, urging users to change their login credentials.

author: NamanyayG
text: Oct 21: Railway detected attackers in systems storing customer secrets; deployments paused, every user told to rotate keys. 12 days later Railway is back in the news over AI agents and secrets.

author: joshmanders
text: They pulled credentials from inside their app's container and used them to request every secret on the platform, ours and every other customer's; tried the cloud metadata endpoint to steal host credentials.

author: kryll_ai
text: SECURITY ALERT: GitBook, a docs platform, hit by AI-assisted breach. Users urged to rotate keys.

author: robot2trade1
text: Binance initial findings on the Oct 29 incident ($6.34B stolen): months-long campaign; in June a Wallet DevOps engineer downloaded a tampered Homebrew installer seeking an AI coding tool.

author: BitcoinNewsCom
text: North Korean hackers used fake job interviews to infiltrate Binance before the $6.34 billion heist.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack: OPSSHIELD says unauthorized access to its cPGuard update CDN let an attacker push a malicious script on Nov 2. Check 5.88.12-5.88.19, update to 5.88.25+, rotate DB and cloud keys.

author: OminouslyPie
text: Nikke CDN supply chain attack: gist documents how it works and what to do.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: LLMjacking is becoming a full-scale cybercriminal business: Google GTIG and Mandiant found criminals hijacking cloud AI access and reselling it.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Google GTIG and Mandiant report LLMjacking incidents driving cloud AI charges above $100,000 per day and up to $1 million, using stolen credentials and API keys.

author: TonTraderCom
text: Hackers ran $100K worth of AI services using stolen API keys; at least nine developer platforms targeted in October to access OpenAI, Anthropic and Amazon Bedrock.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Mandiant details LLMjacking; Kaspersky tracks CyberStrikeAI; Chainlit and AWS MCP have path flaws. Rotate keys. Validate MCP paths.

author: loyndsview
text: An Accenture employee's AI agent ran on the DOD network for two months before it was identified and the vulnerability could be patched.
